bugsFoundAndFixedThisPackage.bug: INSERT has more target columns than expressions
bugsFoundAndFixedThisPackage.cause: writeFilingRows built 17 declared columns but only referenced 12 numbered placeholders plus 4 literals (16 total) in the VALUES tuple, silently dropping org_name from the parameter list even though it was pushed into the values array.
bugsFoundAndFixedThisPackage.fix: Corrected the placeholder template to reference all 13 numbered positions per row (COLUMNS_PER_ROW=13), matching the 13 values actually pushed.

bugsFoundAndFixedThisPackage.bug: IRS 990 extract missing expected field "EIN" — column layout may have changed
bugsFoundAndFixedThisPackage.cause: Live-verified: the 24-vintage extract's header uses "EIN" (uppercase); the 23-vintage extract's header uses "ein" (lowercase) and additionally carries a leading UTF-8 BOM (EF BB BF) that the 24-vintage file does not have. Confirmed by direct byte inspection of both files' headers.
bugsFoundAndFixedThisPackage.fix: parseFilteredRows (and the matching sample-reconciliation logic in CheckNonprofitFinancialsNumbers) now strips a leading BOM if present and does case-insensitive header-field lookup, so a future vintage's casing/encoding quirks do not silently break ingestion.

groundingCorrections: The IRS SOI Form 990 summary extract does not carry a government-specific grant-revenue field (Part VIII Line 1e is not broken out from Line 1h total contributions/grants). 'Government-grant dependency' is computed and labeled as contribution-and-grant revenue dependency instead.

The extract does not carry the Form 990 Part IX program/management/fundraising functional-expense column split. 'Program-vs-admin expense trend' is computed and labeled as a named-administrative-category expense share (management/legal/accounting/lobbying/investment-management fees + office expenses over total functional expenses) — a proxy, not the official allocation.
Scope for this package is Form 990 only, not 990-EZ/990-PF — documented as a boundary, not a silent omission.
